meta.title: Shiyu Runtime
meta.description: View Shiyu runtime state, current work and activity, and inspect Session connections.

title: Shiyu · Runtime
idleHint: No work is executing at the moment.
waitingHint: Waiting for a condition or result.
pausedHint: The runtime is paused. Its current state remains available.
unknownHint: The current runtime state cannot be confirmed.
degradedHint: Some runtime conditions are unavailable. Review the items needing attention.
staleHint: Showing the last successfully read snapshot.
snapshotOld: The snapshot is over 30 seconds old. Waiting for fresh state.
implementationHint: These entries describe implemented scope. See Overview and actual activity for runtime state.
sessionHint: Sessions registered by this runtime and their reported usage.
sessionSelect: Select a session to inspect it
hostDetached: This Shiyu instance is not attached to the Host Session.
hostUnknown: The snapshot does not provide a confirmed Host state.
usageHint: “Not reported” means data is unavailable; it does not mean zero.
probeHint: Creates an empty Session, checks access, then releases and archives it. No model is called.
probeDone: Session access checked. The temporary empty Session was released and archived; no model was called.
probeUnconfirmed: The check receipt does not confirm release, archive, or no model call. Inspect the current Session state.
pausedDone: Pause request completed and the state was refreshed.
resumedDone: Resume request completed and the state was refreshed.
modelVerify: Verify model and Session reuse (2 requests)
modelVerifyHint: Sends only 2 synthetic input turns, with at most 1,024 output tokens per turn.
modelVerifyLimits: Uses opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash (low). No automatic retries or outbound messages.
modelVerifyPending: Waiting for a result or cancellation receipt. Use “Pause runtime” to cancel.
modelVerifyDone: Model and Session reuse verified: 2 requests used the same Session, with no outbound message.
modelVerifyUnconfirmed: The receipt does not fully confirm 2 requests, the same Session, and no outbound message. The result is unconfirmed.
modelVerifyTimeout: No confirmed result after 250 seconds. Inspect the current state; no automatic retry will occur.
tasksHint: Inspect task records, completion criteria, and independent verification results.
tasksUnavailable: Task view is not connected yet
taskSelect: Select a task to inspect it
noUncertainty: No reconciliation reason or evidence recorded
stopPending: A stop request does not confirm cancellation. Execution and external effects still require reconciliation.
localTaskHint: Writes only note.txt in Shiyu’s dedicated directory. Uses deepseek-v4.1-flash (high), at most 2 model steps, and a total output budget of 1,024 tokens.
localTaskLimits: Runs in the background after admission. Success requires independent content and receipt verification. No automatic start or retry. Pause runtime cancels in-flight model work; unconfirmed outcomes remain unknown.
localTaskAccepted: Local task accepted ({id}). Completion depends on its task state and independent verification.
localTaskUnconfirmed: The task admission receipt is incomplete; acceptance is unconfirmed. Refresh task state. No automatic retry will occur.
taskNotInSnapshot: The selected task record is not in the current snapshot yet.
goalVerifyHint: Uses the latest successful local task, rechecks its artifact, then checks Goal creation, pause, resume, and completion. No model inference or outbound message is requested.
goalVerifyDone: Native Goal lifecycle checked: creation, pause, resume, and completion confirmed, with no model inference requested.
goalVerifyUnconfirmed: The Goal receipt does not fully confirm the task, Goal, Session, completion, no inference, and the four-step operation sequence. The result is unconfirmed.
commandUncertain: The result is unconfirmed. Refresh the state before deciding what to do next.
